text: As its meeting on July 13, 2018 the Board of Directors of CreateTO considered Item RA12.1 - CreateTO Recruitment of a Chief Executive Officer. The Board of Directors of CreateTO, on July 13, 2018, agreed to continue to work with an appropriate executive recruitment firm for the hiring of a permanent Chief Executive Officer, targeting an appointment for Council's consideration in the first quarter of 2019.
The Executive Committee received the item for information.
